results.description:
October 20, 2026

💢 A “Protest” to the Allied Commander, a “Request for Support” to China’s Ambassador

At an October 15 parliamentary audit, South Korea’s Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul stated that Seoul had “already conveyed” its objection to remarks by USFK Commander Gen. Brunson.

Just five days later, before Chinese Ambassador Dai Bing, he requested China's “active support” and a “constructive role.”

The same China that repeatedly enters South Korea’s Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) and builds structures in the Yellow Sea.

Protesting to an ally while asking China for peace.

That is the security compass of this fake government.

results.title: Hold on. 🇰🇵 North Korea isn’t suddenly shifting toward a pro-American position. That underlying position has remained unchanged across three
results.description:
Hold on. 🇰🇵 North Korea isn’t suddenly
shifting toward a pro-American position.
That underlying position has remained
unchanged across three generations:
Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il, and Kim Jong Un.
The public simply hasn’t recognized it.

If they had truly aligned themselves
with 🇨🇳 Beijing, North Korea would have
fallen under Chinese control back
in Kim Il Sung’s time.

🇰🇷 South Korea, meanwhile, has already
fallen completely under Beijing’s
control after 30 years of influence
operations.

Even at this extremely dangerous moment
for 🇰🇵 North Korea, South Korea’s defense
minister is meeting with a 🇨🇳 Chinese
official to discuss North Korean issues.

They’re discussing this with 🇨🇳 China,
not the 🇺🇸 United States.
That is the reality right now.
